subject: Farore's Wind
text: Farore's Wind is obtained from a Great Fairy in Zora's Fountain by bombing the wall in the southeast area.

evidence.quote: Farore's Wind is obtained from a Great Fairy in Zora's Fountain.  Use a bomb to open the wall in the southeast area of the fountain, which leads to the Fountain.

subject: Farore's Wind
text: Farore's Wind allows the player to set a waypoint in a dungeon and return to it when casting the spell again elsewhere in the dungeon.

evidence.quote: With it, you can set a Waypoint somewhere in a Dungeon, and using the spell again elsewhere in the dungeon will let you return to the original waypoint.

subject: Boomerang
text: The Boomerang is the dungeon item found in Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

evidence.quote: The Boomerang is the dungeon item in Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

subject: Boomerang
text: The Boomerang can retrieve distant items such as Gold Skulltulas, defeat certain enemies, and stun others.

evidence.quote: An important item for Young Link, as it is the first item in the game which has the ability to grab items and return them to you from a distance.  Namely, Gold Skulltulas.  The Boomerang also has the ability to defeat certain enemies, and stun others.

subject: Boomerang
text: When aiming the Boomerang, lining up the target with the back of Link's head acts as a targeting reticule.

evidence.quote: When aiming the Boomerang, you can use Link's head as a targeting reticule.  Just line up your target with the back of Link's head, and let go.

subject: Ocarina of Time
text: The Ocarina of Time is obtained from the moat outside Hyrule Castle after obtaining all three Spiritual Stones.

evidence.quote: The Ocarina of Time is obtained from the moat outside Hyrule Castle, but only appears there once you have obtained all three of the Spiritual Stones.

subject: Ocarina of Time
text: The Ocarina of Time replaces the Fairy Ocarina and possesses magical qualities that allow the player to open the Door of Time and access the Sacred Realm.

evidence.quote: The Ocarina of Time replaces the Fairy Ocarina that Young Link gets from Saria, and it's magical qualities allows you to open the Door of Time and access the Sacred Realm.

subject: Hookshot
text: The Hookshot is won from Dampe's Ghost underneath his gravestone in Kakariko Graveyard shortly after Link becomes an adult.

evidence.quote: The Hookshot is found almost immediately after Link enters adulthood, and is won from Dampe's Ghost underneath his gravestone in Kakariko Graveyard.

subject: Hookshot
text: The Hookshot allows Adult Link to latch onto wooden objects or special targets, pierce hard armor like that of Big Skulltulas, and retrieve distant Skulltula tokens.

evidence.quote: With it, you can latch onto certain objects in the environment (mostly things made of wood, but also special targets) and pull yourself up to it.  The Hookshot is also a powerful ranged tool, and is able to penetrate certain hard armors (such as the armor of the Big Skulltula).  It can also retrieve distant Skulltula Tokens in the same fashion as the Boomerang.

subject: Fairy Bow
text: The Fairy Bow is the dungeon item obtained from the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: The Fairy Bow is the dungeon item from The Forest Temple.

subject: Fairy Bow
text: Fairy Bow arrows can be infused with Fire, Ice, and Light powers to deal extra damage to enemies and solve puzzles.

evidence.quote: The arrows that the Fairy Bow fires can be enhanced with the powers of Fire, Ice and Light, to deal additional damage to enemies or solve other puzzles.

subject: Megaton Hammer
text: The Megaton Hammer is the dungeon item found in the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote: The Megaton Hammer is the dungeon item from the Fire Temple.

subject: Volvagia
text: The Megaton Hammer is used to solve puzzles and defeat Volvagia, the boss of the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote: The Megaton Hammer is used to solve numerous puzzles and defeat the Fire Temple's boss, Volvagia, but otherwise it's existence is easily forgotten.

subject: Longshot
text: The Longshot is an upgraded Hookshot with double the range and serves as the dungeon item from the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: An upgraded version of the Hookshot, the Longshot is functionally the same but has double the range.  The Longshot is the dungeon item from the Water Temple.

subject: Fire Arrow
text: After completing the Water Temple, shooting an arrow into the morning sun from the south island in Lake Hylia spawns the Fire Arrows on the smaller island.

evidence.quote: To obtain them, complete the Water Temple, then stand on the large island in south of Lake Hylia.  Wait for the sun to rise (the Sun's Song won't work, you'll just have to wait for time to pass normally), then fire an arrow into the sun.  The Fire Arrows will appear on the smaller island.

subject: Fire Arrow
text: Fire Arrows can light distant torches, burn objects such as spider webs, and defeat certain enemies.

evidence.quote: The Fire Arrow can be used to light far off torches, or to burn certain other objects (such as spider webs).  The Fire Arrow is also required to defeat certain enemies.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: The Lens of Truth is found by Young Link inside the Bottom of the Well.

evidence.quote: The Lens of Truth is found by Young Link in the Bottom of the Well, and though he has access to it, there is rarely cause for Young Link to use it.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: The Lens of Truth is required to access the Spirit Temple entrance and defeat the boss of the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote: It is required to defeat the Shadow Temple's boss, as well as to access the entrance to the Spirit Temple.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: Rapidly toggling the Lens of Truth on and off prevents the magic meter from draining.

evidence.quote: The Lens constantly drains a small amount of your magic meter while using it, however rapidly turning the Lens on and off prevents the magic meter from being drained.

subject: Ice Arrow
text: The Ice Arrows are acquired in the Gerudo Training Ground by choosing the left door inside the Treasure Room.

evidence.quote: The Ice Arrows are obtained from the Gerudo Training Ground by taking the left door in the Treasure Room.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Nayru's Love is found inside a cave at the Desert Colossus just before entering the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote: You can get it from a cave in the Desert Colossus just before entering the Spirit Temple, which is good timing since the Iron Knuckles inside the Spirit Temple are vicious competitors.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Nayru's Love grants invulnerability for a limited period of time.

evidence.quote: Nayru's Love makes you invulnerable for a period of time (around a minute, I believe, but I haven't timed it).

subject: Light Arrow
text: Princess Zelda bestows the Light Arrows upon Link in the Temple of Time after all six Medallions have been acquired.

evidence.quote: The Light Arrows are given to Link in the Temple of Time after he has obtained all six Medallions from the Spiritual Sages.

subject: Ganondorf
text: Light Arrows are the only weapons capable of making Ganondorf vulnerable to the Master Sword, and they are required to break the seals in Ganondorf's Keep.

evidence.quote: A gift from Princess Zelda when you finally find her near the end of the game, the Light Arrows are the only weapons in all of Hyrule that can make Ganondorf vulnerable to the power of the Master Sword.  The Light Arrows are also required to destroy the Seals in Ganondorf's Keep.

subject: Zelda's Lullaby
text: Zelda's Lullaby is taught to Link by Impa in Hyrule Castle Garden using the sequence C-Left, C-Up, C-Right, C-Left, C-Up, C-Right.

evidence.quote:
First Found: Hyrule Castle Garden
Sequence: C-Left, C-Up, C-Right, C-Left, C-Up, C-Right

Taught to you by Impa after you first meet Princess Zelda, Zelda's Lullaby is easily the song you will play most throughout the game.

subject: Zelda's Lullaby
text: Zelda's Lullaby is used to open Great Fairy Fountains, enter Darunia's Chamber, access Zora's Domain, and manipulate water levels inside the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: You need to use it to access the Great Fairy Fountains, you must use it to open the door to Darunia's Chamber, you must use it to enter Zora's Domain, you must use it to raise and lower the water levels in the Water Temple... the list goes on.

subject: Epona's Song
text: Epona's Song is taught by Malon at Lon Lon Ranch with the sequence C-Up, C-Left, C-Right, C-Up, C-Left, C-Right.

evidence.quote:
First Found: Lon Lon Ranch
Sequence: C-Up, C-Left, C-Right, C-Up, C-Left, C-Right

Taught to you by Malon in Lon Lon Ranch, Epona's Song has two primary functions: one, it lets you ride Epona as Adult Link, and two, gets you free milk from any cow in the game.

subject: Saria's Song
text: Saria's Song is learned from Saria in the Sacred Forest Meadow with the sequence C-Down, C-Right, C-Left, C-Down, C-Right, C-Left.

evidence.quote:
First Found: Sacred Forest Meadow
Sequence: C-Down, C-Right, C-Left, C-Down, C-Right, C-Left

Taught to you by Saria when you visit her in the Sacred Forest Meadow, Saria's Song is required to get Darunia to trust you, and is later needed to get past Mido in the Lost Woods as Adult Link.

subject: Saria's Song
text: Playing Saria's Song allows Link to communicate telepathically with Saria to receive hints about where to go next.

evidence.quote: It also lets you telepathically communicate with Saria at any time, who will generally give you vague hints about where you should go next.

subject: Sun's Song
text: The Sun's Song is learned in the Royal Family's Tomb in Kakariko Graveyard with the sequence C-Right, C-Down, C-Up, C-Right, C-Down, C-Up, alternating time between 12:00 and 0:00.

evidence.quote: Learned in the Royal Family's Tomb in Kakariko Graveyard, the Sun's Song alternates the time of day between 12:00 (noon) and 0:00 (midnight).

subject: Sun's Song
text: When playing the Sun's Song in a zone where the passage of time is fixed, Link is warped back to the zone entrance upon the time change.

evidence.quote: In a zone where the passage of time is normal, then it will work normally.  In a zone where the passage of time is fixed, then you will be warped back to where you first entered the zone when time changes.
